pageHero.title: Leadership, Advocacy & International Representation
pageHero.subtitle: Leadership and representation across youth-led organizations, international forums, and policy-oriented platforms, with sustained engagement in civic participation, education advocacy, and public speaking.

intro.heading: A record of founding, representing, speaking, and shaping youth-centered institutions.
intro.body: This pillar brings together Mohamed Falfoul’s long-term leadership roles, international representation, speaking engagements, advocacy campaigns, policy contributions, and recognitions across youth, education, health, and civic participation ecosystems.

leadershipRoles.description: Founded and led a youth-driven organization focused on education, civic engagement, and youth empowerment.
highlights: Drove the organization’s early structuring, visibility, and expansion, laying the foundations for sustained national growth.
Led strategic positioning, partnership development, and organizational scaling during its formative years.

leadershipRoles.description: Supported the organization’s strategic orientation and governance following its expansion phase.
highlights: Contributed to institutional continuity, leadership transition, and long-term organizational consolidation.

leadershipRoles.role: Co-Founder & Vice President for International Affairs
leadershipRoles.description: Co-founded and helped structure a student-led federation designed to strengthen representation and international engagement in the health sector.
highlights: Played a key role in the federation’s development, visibility, and outreach during its early growth stage.
Led external relations and international affairs, contributing to expansion of partnerships and broader institutional recognition.

leadershipRoles.description: Contributed to governance and strategic continuity within a national medical student organization.

leadershipRoles.organization: International Federation of Medical Students’ Associations (IFMSA)
leadershipRoles.description: Held a chairing role within international medical student governance and assembly processes.
Engaged in a global network focused on education transformation and youth participation.
Built public speaking, diplomacy, moderation, and negotiation experience through Model United Nations platforms.
